annotation.title_en: Diia.AI: Ukraine's National AI Agent for Government Services
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Public Sector Tech Watch, Interoperable Europe (European Commission)
annotation.venue: Interoperable Europe Portal - Public Sector Tech Watch
annotation.summary_en: Case study page from the EU Public Sector Tech Watch describing Diia.AI, Ukraine's agentic AI chatbot delivering government services via the Diia platform. It covers architecture, PII protection, guardrails, interoperability and benefits. A software agent, not embodied AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Diia.AI is an agentic LLM assistant executing multi-step public service actions in chat
Four-stage PII anonymisation prevents the LLM from processing personal identifiers
Multilayer guardrails combine keyword filtering, ML classification and LLM reasoning against prompt injection
Interoperability follows the European Interoperability Framework, using MCP and RAG with source citations
Projected 30% reduction in human support tickets; challenges include scaling and sovereignty
